name: Trips - Right - 38 Toss

QB.rule: Quick pitch to the tailback in the trips, then run the other way, to the left, like you still have it.

TB.rule: Take the pitch on the run and get to the edge behind the fullback. Ahead of the quarterback is a fumble.

coaching_points: The pitch goes early, to the tailback already in the trips. Do not wait.
The fullback, widest, takes the force man. The slot screens. The tailback turns up outside the fullback.
